additional_info.subject: RE: ID0421762-DC/Si-D/FR-[  MP / R3 170001705 ] Faulty Status CRM:02684000170
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
We kindly request you to visit the charger to check the connections and the functionality of the converter in DC2. Please swap the converter with the neighboring one and see if the problem persists. Additionally, we need to identify which serial number is missing in DC2.
If you swap them and the good converter is now faulty there must be something wrong with the cabling.
It can be CAN or AC.
Also, please refer to the following KAs for troubleshooting-
